_comment: Hand-written pre-extraction (A3), updated after B2.2 reproduce run.
Anchor set: Import, ImportLazy, Extend with transitive closure (A1).
UseTransitive = Use/Call edge whose src-file has no import anchor to tgt-file.

mode_preserving_policy.non_scoped_default: UseTransitive EXPORTED as UseTransitive (v0.3.9 behavior). --exclude-transitive-use opts out.
mode_preserving_policy.grep_confirm: UseTransitive is NON-QUOTABLE BY DESIGN — no import line exists from src to tgt. Consumers (e.g. ARCH_AGENT grep-confirm) must treat UseTransitive as expected-unquotable, not a failure.

use_transitive_edges.mechanism: re-export via __init__.py — import shim; shim.Color.RED resolves Color/RED to defs.py
re-export via named module — import shim.enums; shim.enums.Color.GREEN resolves to defs.py
DI injection — svc.process() resolves to Service.process in base.py, no import to base
module ref — import shim creates module binding without Import edge (StackGraphs behavior)

_note: StackGraphs with 'import X' (not 'from X import Y') does NOT create Import to the
re-exporting module in some cases. The attribute access (shim.Color) creates Use edges
that resolve through the re-export chain to the definition site (defs.py).
For 'from shim.enums import Color' style, StackGraphs resolves Import directly to defs.py,
anchoring the file pair. The 'import X; X.attr' style leaves them unanchored.
The inheritance variant also produces UseTransitive: subclass-mediated access
(e.g. main imports Passenger which extends Person; main.py -> person.py is UseTransitive).
This is demonstrated by the SECOND toy baseline (18 relabels, see second_toy_ut_baseline.json).
